headline: Impeachment Day 18: Ortonio Says VP Sara Knew, Authorized and Supervised Confidential Funds
seoTitle: Impeachment Day 18: Ortonio Testifies on VP Sara's Role | FMB News
seoDescription: OVP Assistant Secretary Lemuel Ortonio testified on August 25 that Vice President Sara Duterte knew, authorized and supervised the handling of OVP confidential funds.
deck: The hostile witness testified that the Vice President knew about, authorized and supervised confidential-fund handling from request through liquidation; the defense retains the right to challenge the evidence.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Day 18 of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial put Office of the Vice President confidential-fund procedures under sustained scrutiny as Assistant Secretary and Assistant Chief of Staff Lemuel Ortonio testified as a hostile witness.

According to Philippine News Agency reporting, Ortonio told the impeachment court that Duterte knew about, authorized and supervised the handling of OVP confidential funds from their request through release, spending and liquidation.

sections.heading: What the testimony established
paragraphs: Ortonio also confirmed that the OVP's request for confidential funds was submitted without supporting documents detailing the planned confidential activities at the time of the request. He testified about the movement and liquidation of the funds and the office's responses to audit findings.

House prosecutors described the testimony as material to their allegation of irregularities. Those assertions remain part of the prosecution case and are not a final finding of liability against the Vice President.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The testimony followed the court's decision earlier on August 25 to declare Ortonio a hostile witness, allowing prosecutors to use leading questions. The proceeding concerns allegations over the handling of confidential funds at the OVP and Department of Education.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The testimony goes directly to the prosecution's effort to establish who knew about and controlled the use of confidential public funds. The impeachment court must still weigh the testimony, documentary record and defense response before reaching any finding.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The impeachment court is expected to continue examining testimony and documentary evidence. The defense retains the opportunity to challenge the prosecution's interpretation of the records and present its own evidence under the court's rules.
